problem_statement: Develop autonomous edge AI systems that empower remote Himalayan health workers with real-time diagnostic triage and low-bandwidth telemetry sync.
Design decentralized micro-lending verification engines using zero-knowledge proofs to unlock collateral-free credit for informal agricultural cooperatives.
Engineer an urban climate resilience telemetry dashboard that correlates IoT hydrological sensors and satellite radar data to predict flash flooding in under 12 minutes.
Create multimodal educational agents capable of dynamically converting vernacular audio dialect into interactive STEAM problem sets for primary schoolers without high-speed internet.
